description: Source code for the Smarty internal plugin that compiles the {section} template tags, including classes for handling the compilation of sections, section else blocks, and section close tags within the Smarty template engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Section
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {section} tag for defining loops within Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Sectionelse
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {sectionelse} tag signaling an alternate block in section loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Sectionclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/section} closing tag for section blocks.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {section} tag into PHP code, setting up the loop control variables and logic.

methods.description: Compiles the {sectionelse} tag into PHP, marking the else block for section loops.

methods.name: compile
